revenue.source: Chevron FY2025 10-K (acc. 0000093410-26-000078), Sales and other operating revenues; excludes equity-affiliate and other income

operating_income.source: Derived: Income before income tax (29,584; 27,506; 19,743; from 10-K FY2025 via edgar.tools) + Interest and debt expense (469; 594; 1,217; 10-K). Chevron reports no operating income line; includes equity affiliate income and other income

d_and_a.source: Chevron FY2025 10-K cash flow statement, Depreciation, depletion and amortization

capex.source: Chevron FY2025 10-K cash flow statement, Capital expenditures

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 +8% for full-year contribution of Hess (acquired 2025) at flat prices; thereafter 2-3% roughly inflation-level, with commodity prices held flat

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 11.4% (20,960/184,432), FY2024 14.5%, FY2023 15.3%; 12% reflects Hess synergies/cost cuts offset by mid-cycle commodity prices

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate 36.8% (7,258/19,743), FY2024 35.5%, FY2023 27.6%; 33% is a blend leaning to recent levels given high international/Upstream mix

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 10.9% (20,132/184,432), FY2024 8.9%; 10.5% reflects higher DD&A base post-Hess, easing slightly

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 9.4% (17,347/184,432), FY2024 8.5%; ~9.5% consistent with ~$17-18B capex run-rate; capex slightly below D&A

wacc.source: Assumption: ~4.3% risk-free, ~5% ERP, beta ~0.9-1.0 giving ~9% cost of equity, ~5% pre-tax debt cost, ~15% debt weight; not sourced from a data provider

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run inflation-like growth, below nominal GDP, conservative for an oil major facing energy transition

net_debt.source: Chevron Q4 2025 earnings release / FY2025 10-K: net debt at 12/31/2025 = total debt 40,758 less cash 6,293, time deposits 4 (marketable securities nil); includes finance leases in total debt per Chevron's definition (excl. NCI 5,726)

diluted_shares.source: Derived: FY2025 net income attributable to Chevron 12,299 / diluted EPS 6.63 = ~1,855M weighted-average diluted shares; exact FY figure not found in search results (9M 2025 was 1,808M; Hess shares issued in Q3). Reviewer should verify in 10-K
